title: 四个主题二十问
source_doc: course/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/35_Safety Quiz - 2025 Workplace Safety Work at Height Safety Electrical Safety Fire.md
author_source: project/Laboratory Ergonomics & RSI/35_Safety Quiz - 2025 Workplace Safety Work at Height Safety Electrical Safety Fire/src.py

points.K1: 测验形式：四个主题各五题
points.K2: 风险评估：识别并控制风险
points.K8: 坠落制动：坠落时接住人
points.K12: 电气事故多因人为失误
points.K14: 接地故障断路器防触电

shots.scene: 欣欣戴绿色安全帽，身后四个主题卡片，向镜头招手
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot wearing a green safety helmet waves at the camera in front of four topic cards.
shots.narration: 四个主题二十问，开始！

shots.scene: 四个图标：工厂、梯子、闪电、火焰
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a factory, a ladder, a lightning bolt and a flame. No people.
shots.narration: 工作场所、高处、电气、消防。

shots.scene: 车间休息室，阿杰和小研坐在桌前
shots.prompt_en: In a workshop break room, the young male student and the female graduate student sit at a table.
shots.narration: 阿杰和小研要一起备考安全知识。

shots.section_title: 测验形式：四个主题各五题
shots.scene: 四本题册，每本二十格，各圈出五格
shots.prompt_en: Four booklets with twenty boxes each, five boxes circled in each. No people.
shots.narration: 每个主题二十题，今天每个讲五题。
overlay: 测验形式：四个主题各五题

shots.section_title: 测验形式：四个主题各五题
shots.scene: 答案卡和解释卡
shots.prompt_en: An answer card next to an explanation card. No people.
shots.narration: 四选一，每题都有解释。

shots.section_title: 风险评估：识别并控制风险
shots.scene: 风险矩阵图标
shots.prompt_en: A risk matrix icon. No people.
shots.narration: 工作场所第一题：风险评估的主要目的？
overlay: 风险评估：识别并控制风险

shots.section_title: 风险评估：识别并控制风险
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案a，识别危害，评价风险，提出控制措施。

shots.scene: 噪声、振动、压力、辐射四个图标
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a loud speaker, vibration waves, a stressed head and a radiation symbol. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：哪个不是物理危害？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案c，压力，它属于心理危害。

shots.scene: 梯子图标
shots.prompt_en: A ladder icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：梯子安全的金规则是什么？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案b，保持三点接触。

shots.scene: 两手一脚接触梯子的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of two hands and one foot touching a ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 两手一脚或两脚一手，身体才稳。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔五层
shots.prompt_en: An inverted pyramid with five layers. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：危害控制的第一步是什么？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案b，消除。

shots.scene: 五层依次亮起
shots.prompt_en: The five layers light up from top to bottom. No people.
shots.narration: 消除、替代、工程、管理，最后个人防护。

shots.scene: 红、蓝、绿、黄四个色块
shots.prompt_en: Four color blocks: red, blue, green and yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：安全信息标志用什么颜色？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案c，绿色。

shots.scene: 平台边缘和梯子图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a platform edge and a ladder. No people.
shots.narration: 高处第一题：什么是高处作业？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案b，高于地面或楼面、坠落会受伤的作业。

shots.section_title: 坠落制动：坠落时接住人
shots.scene: 全身式安全带和挂绳
shots.prompt_en: A full body harness with a lanyard. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：坠落制动系统的主要目的？
overlay: 坠落制动：坠落时接住人

shots.section_title: 坠落制动：坠落时接住人
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案b，发生坠落时把人接住。

shots.scene: 挂绳伸展的示意
shots.prompt_en: A diagram of a lanyard extending during a fall. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：最大允许自由坠落距离？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：2米。

shots.scene: 高度标尺
shots.prompt_en: A height scale icon. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：多高起一般需要防坠落保护？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：1.8米，也就是6英尺。

shots.scene: 安全带挂着一个人形图标悬停
shots.prompt_en: A harness holds a person icon suspended in the air. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：安全带的主要作用？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案c，坠落时保护作业人员。

shots.scene: 冲击力分散到全身的箭头
shots.prompt_en: Arrows show impact force spread across the body. No people.
shots.narration: 分散冲击力，悬挂着等待救援。

shots.section_title: 电气事故多因人为失误
shots.scene: 触电闪电图标
shots.prompt_en: An electric shock icon. No people.
shots.narration: 电气第一题：电气事故的主要原因？
overlay: 电气事故多因人为失误

shots.section_title: 电气事故多因人为失误
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案b，人为失误。

shots.section_title: 电气事故多因人为失误
shots.scene: 操作不当、不懂、没培训、不按程序
shots.prompt_en: Four icons: a wrong hand action, a question mark, no certificate and a skipped checklist. No people.
shots.narration: 操作不当、缺乏认识、没培训、不按程序。

shots.scene: 起重机吊臂靠近架空电线
shots.prompt_en: A crane boom approaching overhead power lines. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：离架空电线要保持多远？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案：6米，防止吊臂碰线。

shots.section_title: 接地故障断路器防触电
shots.scene: 插座上的漏电保护装置
shots.prompt_en: A ground fault protection device on an outlet. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：这个断路器缩写指什么？
overlay: 接地故障断路器防触电

shots.section_title: 接地故障断路器防触电
shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案a，接地故障断路器。

shots.section_title: 接地故障断路器防触电
shots.scene: 漏电时开关自动跳开
shots.prompt_en: The device trips automatically when current leaks. No people.
shots.narration: 一检测到漏电就断电，主讲人比作漏电断路器。

shots.scene: 电器起火，旁边一桶水打叉
shots.prompt_en: An electrical fire with a bucket of water crossed out. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：电气火灾为什么不能用水？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案c，水导电，会增加触电风险。

shots.scene: 四个色块
shots.prompt_en: Four color blocks: red, blue, green and yellow. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：电气危险警告标志用什么颜色？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案c，黄色。

shots.scene: 火三角
shots.prompt_en: A fire triangle with icons of oxygen, heat and fuel. No people.
shots.narration: 消防第一题：火三角是什么？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案b，氧气、热量、可燃物。

shots.scene: 室外集合点标志和人群
shots.prompt_en: An assembly point sign outdoors with person icons gathering. No people.
shots.narration: 第二题：火灾集合点是什么？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案b，疏散时人员集合的安全区域。

shots.scene: 灭火器挂着检查标签
shots.prompt_en: A fire extinguisher with an inspection tag. No people.
shots.narration: 第三题：灭火器多久检查一次？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案c，每月，检查后在标签上记日期。

shots.scene: 安全出口标志
shots.prompt_en: An emergency exit sign. No people.
shots.narration: 第四题：安全出口标志指示什么？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案b，火灾时最安全的疏散路线。

shots.scene: 房间里火焰突然铺满
shots.prompt_en: Flames suddenly spread across an entire room. No people.
shots.narration: 第五题：火灾中的轰燃是什么？

shots.scene: 正确选项卡片亮起并打勾
shots.prompt_en: The correct option card lights up with a green check. No people.
shots.narration: 答案b，火焰突然蔓延到整个区域。

shots.scene: 房间里的物品同时着火
shots.prompt_en: All items in the room ignite at the same time. No people.
shots.narration: 高温让区域内可燃物几乎同时起火。

shots.scene: 欣欣站在白板前
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot stands at a whiteboard.
shots.narration: 压力是心理危害，梯子三点接触。

shots.scene: 倒金字塔和绿色标志
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an inverted pyramid and a green sign. No people.
shots.narration: 控制先消除，安全信息用绿色。

shots.scene: 安全带和高度标尺
shots.prompt_en: Icons of a harness and a height scale. No people.
shots.narration: 自由坠落2米，1.8米起要防坠落。

shots.scene: 架空电线、黄色标志、水桶打叉
shots.prompt_en: Icons of power lines, a yellow sign and a crossed-out bucket. No people.
shots.narration: 离电线6米，警告用黄色，电火不用水。

shots.scene: 灭火器和集合点图标
shots.prompt_en: Icons of an extinguisher and an assembly point. No people.
shots.narration: 灭火器每月查，疏散到集合点。

shots.scene: 欣欣挥手告别
shots.prompt_en: The panda mascot waves goodbye.
shots.narration: 四个主题二十问到这里，下次见！
